parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description:
The ID of the configuration.
>Call the [DescribeCycleTaskList](~~DescribeCycleTaskList~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the task. Valid values:
- **1**: enabled.
- **0**: disabled.

parameters.name: PeriodUnit
parameters.description:
The unit of the scan cycle. Valid values:
- **day**: day.
- **hour**: hour.

parameters.name: TargetEndTime
parameters.description: The task end time, in hours.

parameters.name: TargetStartTime
parameters.description: The task start time, in hours.

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description:
The node name. Valid values:
- **VIRUS\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: virus scan.
- **IMAGE_SCAN**: image scan.
- **EMG\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: emergency vulnerability scanning.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description:
The node type. Valid values:
- **VIRUS\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: virus scan.
- **IMAGE_SCAN**: image scan.
- **EMG\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: emergency vulnerability scanning.
